description: Cross-harness matrix suite for the mail-collab plugin's five skills (exchange, google-workspace, m365, overview, postfix). Prompts are deliberately neutral (no 'according to the skills library') so the no-skill arm is not tipped off. Every expected answer is traceable to cited content shipped in each skill's SKILL.md on 2026-08-09. knowledge: 'recent' = fact a bare model plausibly lacks (post-cutoff, dated, or niche); 'stable' = long-standing fact a strong bare model may know.

tasks.prompt: In Microsoft Exchange, what is the default retention period, in days, for delivered messages kept by the Safety Net feature so they can be resubmitted after a database failover? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/mail-collab/skills/exchange/SKILL.md - Safety Net: Retains delivered messages for 2 days (default). Enables resubmission after database failover.

tasks.prompt: For a properly architected Exchange Database Availability Group, how many total copies of each mailbox database does Microsoft recommend maintaining? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/mail-collab/skills/exchange/SKILL.md - Preferred Architecture: 4 copies per database (2 per datacenter), 3 HA copies + 1 lagged copy.

tasks.prompt: When does mainstream support end for Exchange Server 2019, after which organizations must rely on Extended Security Updates to stay protected? Answer concisely with the month and year.
tasks.notes: plugins/mail-collab/skills/exchange/SKILL.md - Exchange 2019 (end-of-support October 2025, ESU available); Version Matrix support status row confirms Oct 2025.

tasks.prompt: In Google Workspace, what is the maximum number of domains, combining primary, alias, and secondary domains, that a single account can have? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/mail-collab/skills/google-workspace/SKILL.md - Account Model: Up to 600 domains (primary + alias + secondary).

tasks.prompt: When generating a new DKIM signing key for a domain in the Google Workspace Admin Console, what key length in bits is recommended? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/mail-collab/skills/google-workspace/SKILL.md - DKIM Configuration: Click Generate new record (2048-bit recommended).

tasks.prompt: When migrating from Google Workspace to Microsoft 365 with a tool like GWMME, does the migration bring over Google Chat history and Meet recordings along with email, calendar, and contacts? Answer in one sentence.
tasks.notes: plugins/mail-collab/skills/google-workspace/SKILL.md - Migration > Google Workspace to M365: Migrates email/calendar/contacts. Does NOT migrate: Chat history, Meet recordings, Google Sites.

tasks.prompt: Under Microsoft 365 E1 licensing, what is the Exchange Online mailbox storage limit? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/mail-collab/skills/m365/SKILL.md - Enterprise Plans table: Exchange mailbox row, E1 = 50 GB.

tasks.prompt: As of 2026, does the Microsoft 365 E3 license include Defender for Office 365 Plan 1? Answer in one sentence.
tasks.notes: plugins/mail-collab/skills/m365/SKILL.md - Enterprise Plans table: Defender for O365 row shows E3 = Plan 1 (2026).

tasks.prompt: Among the essential Conditional Access policies recommended for a Microsoft 365 tenant, which legacy authentication protocols should be blocked entirely? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/mail-collab/skills/m365/SKILL.md - Essential policies #3: Block legacy authentication (IMAP, POP3, SMTP AUTH).

tasks.prompt: Which Postfix release first added support for TLSRPT reporting under RFC 8460? Answer concisely with the version number.
tasks.notes: plugins/mail-collab/skills/postfix/SKILL.md - Key differences: 3.10 added TLSRPT support; Version Differences table row TLSRPT (RFC 8460): No / New.

tasks.prompt: In Postfix, is the smtpd_forbid_unauth_pipelining protection enabled by default starting in version 3.10, compared to version 3.9 where it was merely available as an option? Answer in one sentence.
tasks.notes: plugins/mail-collab/skills/postfix/SKILL.md - Version Differences table: smtpd_forbid_unauth_pipelining is Available in 3.9, Default enabled in 3.10.

tasks.prompt: In Postfix configuration, is it acceptable to list the same domain in both mydestination and virtual_mailbox_domains at the same time? Answer in one sentence.
tasks.notes: plugins/mail-collab/skills/postfix/SKILL.md - Virtual Domains: Critical rule: Never list the same domain in both mydestination and virtual_mailbox_domains.

tasks.prompt: When migrating an on-premises Exchange organization to Exchange Online, at what mailbox count does a full hybrid deployment become the recommended approach instead of a simple cutover migration? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/mail-collab/skills/overview/SKILL.md - Migration path table: Exchange on-prem to Exchange Online: Full Hybrid (>150 mailboxes), Cutover (<150).

tasks.prompt: Ahead of a mail platform cutover, what TTL value in seconds should you lower your MX records to, so DNS changes propagate quickly during the transition? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/mail-collab/skills/overview/SKILL.md - DNS Cutover Checklist #1: Lower MX TTL to 300 seconds at least 48 hours before cutover.

tasks.prompt: Roughly what is the list price per user per month for Microsoft 365 E3, in US dollars, based on current enterprise pricing benchmarks? Answer concisely with an approximate figure.
tasks.notes: plugins/mail-collab/skills/overview/SKILL.md - Step 2 table, Pricing (enterprise) row: E3 ~36 dollars/user/mo, E5 ~60 dollars/user/mo.
